lines.en: label tsuneyospring2:
Somewhere kind of far-ish from where you are right now or something...
scene tsuneyorevisits1
: Why in Grom’s great green gonads did you bring me here, Tsuneyo? You know my race does not fare well when exposed to the light of Ra.
: You know what they say, Emerald Guardian — when in Rome, go to an amusement park.
: So we’re in Rome now?
: No wonder why men are always thinking of their empire. This seems lively and exciting. Just look at all of the shadowy figures happily roaming around.
scene tsuneyorevisits2
: You know, when you told me you had a quest you needed help with, I was kind of hoping it would be one I could handle from a gaming chair.
: What is earth if not a gaming chair for experiencing pleasant outdoor excursions with a small Caucasian girl?
: A planet, I think.
: Planet-shmanet, Janet. I hope you brought your questing pants.
scene tsuneyorevisits3
: Are shorts okay? And you’re not going to make me ride anything, are you? I’ll get motion sickness and I’m trying not to throw up in front of people anymore.
: I am not quite sure what I am going to make you do. I just felt that I was supposed to bring someone here.
scene tsuneyorevisits4
: Hah...why’s it always an escort quest?
: Just do your best to not aggro any unnecessary mobs as my magical energy comes from the moon and I can’t imagine that it will be logging in for at least another hour or two.
: Do you want the experience points or not? Because it is beginning to sound as if you don’t.

: Not if they come at the expense of my energy. I must think of self-preservation before anything, Kendo Princess. And thanks to the Dark Successor’s homework, I haven’t had a single bar of rested in weeks.
: Then leave and I will do this on my own.
scene tsuneyorevisits5

: I understand that you have accepted your position as a “side heroine” in the life of the man you routinely call the protagonist of our story, but that man has all but vanished and I am the protagonist now.
: I do not have the time for side characters. And I have asked you to join me today for the sake of my quest, which makes you my main heroine.
: But as always, you refuse to return the favor and fervor that I give to you when you take the time out of your life to show me the things you love. It’s the cooking contest all over again.
: Do you really have to scold me, though? I had no idea you loved amusement parks until literally right now.
scene tsuneyorevisits6
: I don’t like amusement parks.
: Well, then what does your lecture have to do with anything?!
: Just once, I would like to have you do something I want without having to talk you into it. That’s all.
scene tsuneyorevisits7
: There’s some reason I needed to come here, but I’m unsure as to what it actually is. And I believed that retracing my steps would be the only way to figure that out.
: The problem is that I have never been here before. I’ve only seen this place in dreams — so the act of retracing anything seems difficult.
scene tsuneyorevisits8
: Dreams, you say?...
: Something of the sort, at least. I can’t quite wrap my head around it.
: Tsuneyo...
: I understand what’s happening now...
scene tsuneyorevisits9
: You do?
: Those aren’t dreams you’re having! They’re memories from a different timeline! A previous life you’ve lived! And you’re trying to get them back because they’re important to you!
: So, you are saying I have been here before?
: Most assuredly so! I’ve watched more than enough anime to know just how often Japanese girls are getting wrapped up in tragic, time-based conflicts!
: Which means you were right, Kendo Princess! You are the protagonist after all!
scene tsuneyorevisits10
: Which also means I’m finally the main heroine! Yes! Yes, it’s all so clear now! I just needed to wait for a yuri spin-off! Thank you anime-Jesus!
: Does this mean you will participate in the excursion without being a pansy-ass bitch about it?
scene black
: Participate?! I’m gonna lead the charge like all good heroines do!
: Oh! But first, takoyaki. Come!
scene tsuneyorevisits11
: Aaaaand now comes the part where we have to wait two weeks to be able to eat it without burning our tongues off. Fun.
scene tsuneyorevisits12
: What’s going on? Are you unlocking another memory? Does it have anything to do with the lewd arrangement of ingredients? Do you have secret sexual trauma I’ve never learned about?
: Tell me so I can use my heroine powers to fix you.
: This does seem familiar. Perhaps I’ve eaten this in one of my dreams that aren’t actually dreams according to your animation logic.
: It would also help explain why the vendor started crying and screaming as soon as he saw you. There must have been some sort of tragic occurrence where-
scene tsuneyorevisits13
: Ah! Tsuneyo! This must have been how you died! You choked on takoyaki!
: I am a warrior. I would never be defeated by balls.
scene tsuneyorevisits14
: Unless...they were poisoned.
scene tsuneyorevisits15
: Poisoned balls...the worst kind.
: Drop ‘em, Kendo Princess. Show those vendors we don’t take kindly to assassination attempts around here.
: Good idea, Emerald Guardian. Thank you for saving my life.
: The best healers are proactive, not reactive. Let this be a lesson to you going forward.
scene tsuneyorevisits16
: Now! To find food that we can actually eat! Mount up, Kendo Princess!
: Come, legs. Let us find the secrets of my death together.
scene tsuneyorevisits17

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits18
: Tsuneyo? What’s wrong? You’ve seen the corpses of so many chickens throughout your life. Why are these ones getting you down?
: It’s just that this seems familiar as well. Like I’m experiencing the same events all over again, but coming no closer to uncovering the truth.
: This one too? The takoyaki is one thing, but if everything you eat is killing you, it could imply that there’s a secret criminal organization directly targeting you. And that’s way harder to fix..
: We’d need a whole team of heroines to band together in order to stand-up to a group like that. This quest is turning into an entire game, Kendo Princess. We must be vigilant or-
: What if...it’s something else entirely?
: What do you mean?
scene tsuneyorevisits19
: I’m not quite sure. But something about the way these mangled and seasoned corpses make me feel does not scream “fear” to me.
: Besides, the only organization I am affiliated with in any way is the Produce Delivery Administration, and chicken is certainly not a vegetable as far as my culinary knowledge extends.
: Well, if these memories aren’t sticking out to you because they’re scaring you, how are they making you feel?
scene tsuneyorevisits20
: It’s difficult to say...it’s not a way I’ve ever felt before.
: But when I’m holding this platter...inhaling the scent of charcoal and listening to choruses of laughter in the background...it’s like...
: It’s like I am missing something.
: Like there is an element to this experience that once existed and just...doesn’t anymore.
: But what could that be?
: And why does it make me feel somewhat empty?
: The only explanation is that noodles are involved in some way. I do not feel this strongly about anything else.
: I don’t know, Tsuneyo...the way you’re talking about it now makes it sound kind of like you’ve gone on a date here or something.
scene tsuneyorevisits21
: That is impossible. I harbor no romantic interest for anyone and would never react this strongly to such a thing.
: You haven’t experienced anything like that in this life, sure. But what if you’re part of some kind of game where love transcends time? And you need to find your way back to your lover? Or-
scene tsuneyorevisits22
: Wait...
: If you brought me here...
: Do you...do you think that might mean we...
: In another life...
: You and I...together...
: I do not understand. What are you implying?
: That we...that maybe my memories are also...and...you know...
: I’m still confused. Be direct or I will not understand.
scene tsuneyorevisits23
: I’m saying we must have been in love in another life and are now reliving this date because the universe is trying to get us back together!
: Your feelings for me are so strong that they’re manipulating time itself! Your memories are creeping back in!
: I’m sorry, Kendo Princess! I’ll try to get mine back as soon as-
: Emerald Guardian.
: I’m sorry! I’m trying!
: There is no need to apologize.
: When I said I harbor no romantic interest for anyone, that included you. You are a friend. And you are a very good friend, but that is all.
: But you don’t know that for sure! Your memories are-
: Emerald Guardian, I am a heterosexual woman. Such a thing would never happen between us.
scene tsuneyorevisits24
: Oh...right. I forgot straight people still exist in 2020. My bad.
: What’s curious is if romantic feelings are at the core of this emptiness....that there are only two men in my life who it could be. And one of them is my father.
: Maybe you just...like older guys then?
: No...it must be something else.
scene black
: Come. We’ll keep looking. There must be another hint somewhere.
: Wait, are we not eating first?!
: Eat and walk. We don’t have time.
: I thought we weren’t supposed to do that in this country?!
scene tsuneyorevisits25
: Gaaaaaah! Can we go home now? We’ve been here for hours and are still no closer to the truth.
scene tsuneyorevisits26
: Or at least no closer to you accepting that love might actually be the culprit after all.
: Death seems more plausible when compared to that.
: Not really, Kendo Princess. And the more I think about it, the more sense it makes. I mean, there’s no way you’ve been killed by every food item here, right?
: That does sound implausible. But it could be the universe’s way of telling me to always prepare a meal at home instead of allowing other vendors to price-gouge me.
: Or...you could have gone on a date here.
: Is that really such a bad thing?
scene tsuneyorevisits27
: What if our approach in general, treating this as the convergence of timelines, is what’s flawed? What if it’s more complicated than that?

: Chances are it is more complicated than that. But I start to zone out whenever shows start getting to the specific metaphysics of situations like this. Just say “time stuff” and leave it at that. GG.
: But what if...it’s the opposite?
: The opposite? What?
: What if...
scene tsuneyorevisits28
: I’ve been predicting the future this whole time?
: Odin’s ovaries, you’ve cracked the code! This whole time, all those things felt familiar because they were premonitions! You’re a soothsayer!
: I’ve always known my presence was soothing. This is no surprise to me.
: Not what that means but yeah!
: What else happens, then? What else do you see that hasn’t come true yet?
: I see...
scene tsuneyorevisits29
: I see...
scene black
: I see that.
scene tsuneyorevisits30
: Hah...
: Did I really have to wait all the way down here?
scene tsuneyorevisits31
: Thank you for coming on such short notice. I understand that you’ve been very busy being useless lately and do not have much time to engage in normal human activities anymore.
: I mean...this call has some pretty serious implications and turning it down would have been a terrible idea for a lot of different reasons, but yeah. You’re welcome, I guess.
: This happened sooner than I thought it would, though.
scene tsuneyorevisits32
: I see. So you must already know about my powers.
: Your what?
: As it turns out, I am what the Emerald Guardian calls a “soothsayer.” Which means that I can predict the future, and that is somehow soothing.
: Uhh...
scene tsuneyorevisits33
: A terrible fate will soon befall you, bro. And while I do not know the specifics of that terrible fate, I know that it exists.
: And I know that it is terrible because you are involved. And that automatically makes it terrible.
: And it must be true as I’ve been seeing this very image in my sleep. Being up here on this metal wheel with you. I see it sometimes when I blink too.
: I’ve seen everything here today over and over and over again...and so I took it upon myself to investigate why as it was starting to become distracting in my daily life.
: But seeing as I have now informed you of your impending terrible fate in a soothing manner, my mind should go back to normal and I can start thinking more about noodles again.
: You are welcome, by the way. I will not charge for my services the first time. But any tragedies I prevent in the future will require a small donation. Thank you for your understanding.
: You really think you’re seeing the future?
: It’s the only thing that makes sense.
: You don’t think those visions might be memories?
scene tsuneyorevisits34
: The Guardian and I toyed with the idea, but ultimately decided this made more sense as we could not come up with a reasonable explanation for why I was ever here in the first place.
: You brought me here.
scene tsuneyorevisits35
: Yes, and I have already thanked you for coming. So it is only right to thank me as well for-
: No, I mean you brought me here in the past.
: ...What?
: This is a memory. We’ve done this before.
scene tsuneyorevisits36
: We’ve...what?...
: No...I’m a soothsayer. I’m predicting the future. I’ve summoned you here to protect you from something.
: You haven’t.
: I have.
: You haven’t, Tsuneyo.
: You’re remembering something you’re not supposed to remember. But I don’t know why you’re remembering it and that...is confusing to me. But we can try and figure that out later.
: Why...were we here? The Guardian made it sound like this would be a date.
: It kind of was.
: But you are not my boyfriend. You’re-
scene tsuneyorevisits37
: My...husband...
: I asked you to take me here again...
: And it looks like I didn’t even have to.
scene tsuneyorevisits38
: Ngh!
: Tsuneyo? Are you okay?
: It’s...my head...
: Something...ngh...
: It hurts!...
: Just take a deep breath and-
scene tsuneyorevisits39
: Hah...hah...hah......ngah!
: Just take a deep breath and remember who you are. Not where you are.
: Do you...know what’s happening to me?...
: Do you...know what this is?...
: A little yes, a little no. And I’m mostly winging it right now, but it’s something we might be able to figure out if-
scene tsuneyorevisits40
: Hah...hah...hah!
: It’s something we might be able to figure out if we can talk about it.
: It’s not just you. The world is looping.
: Stop...
: Ayane and Makoto know about it already. And if you can bring yourself to listen-
scene tsuneyorevisits41
: Si...lence!...
: I’ll get in contact with them. We can tell you everything. Just try to-
scene black
: Enough! Enough! I’ve heard enough!
: Tomorrow...
: Bring them...to Tojo Ramen...
: Bring them...
: To me...
